description:
## Problem
On 2026-11-17 the owner chose "Also add pause and retry for small holder trees (relaxes the kill policy)". It was not built. On 2026-11-20 the owner chose to file pause as "a design-only item that ends at your approval".

## Change
Write a design, linked from this item: what is suspended and how; what happens to memory, the host lock, containers and VMs the job started, and benchmark timings inside a paused job; when the kill still fires; how a paused run is marked so its timings are never published. State the evidence that pausing would have saved a run, from the breach history, or that there is none.

## Decision gates
No code. The item goes to `blocked` with the design linked, for the owner's approval.

## Verification rubric
Pass: the design answers each point above and cites the breach records it relies on.

## Guardrails (accepted by the owner, 2026-11-20)
The agent never posts a stand-in review, resolves a review thread, closes and reopens a pull request to restart CI, uses `--no-verify`, force-pushes, rewrites an author, or deletes anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`. It arms with `make pr-arm` once per pull request and reports the result. Subagents are read-only. Any limit, default, threshold or label text is shown to the owner before it is committed. A blocked step stops this item; the agent moves to the next item and does not work around the block.
